verdict.rationale: Lighthouse documents an employer-facing service: it says it handles the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire, and its Plus plan adds compliance support, consolidated billing, candidate progress reports and workforce pathway planning. The evidence never names H-1B registrations or transfers, LCA filing or compliance, or specific employer paperwork, so only the general employer-sponsorship side is shown. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery and transfer service, LCA preparation and compliance (public access file, wage obligations), an itemized list of employer-side forms handled, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: Lighthouse handles the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire, so your roles never stall on a visa.
